2026-11-08-154.title: Error and usage records reach us from every browser
2026-11-08-154.body: Madar now sends its error and usage records through its own address, so an ad blocker no longer stops them. What Madar records is the same: never what you type, chat messages or amounts. Details in Settings.

2026-11-08-153.title: Your lists load after a short server fault
2026-11-08-153.body: When a Madar server fails for a few seconds, the page now tries again by itself. Before, you saw "The data did not load." and had to press Retry.
